outgoing.name: Africa
outgoing.excerpt: This small passerine bird is strongly migratory, and winters in tropical Africa, Arabia and India.

outgoing.name: Asia
outgoing.excerpt: The Whitethroat, Sylvia communis, is a common and widespread Old World warbler which breeds throughout Europe and across much of temperate western Asia.

outgoing.name: Fruit
outgoing.excerpt: Like most warblers, it is insectivorous, but will also take berries and other soft fruit.
